jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: The Global Analytics team is looking for a Data Scientist to guide measurement, strategy, and tactical decision-making using Advanced Analytics approaches as DoorDash expands its logistics platform across Australia.
jobs.description:
## About DoorDash Australia

DoorDash is the leading last-mile logistics platform in North America, and its Australian operations are growing rapidly. The Global Analytics team partners with product, operations, and marketing to drive data-informed decisions at scale.

## About the Role

As a Data Scientist at DoorDash Australia, you will guide measurement, strategy, and tactical decision-making using advanced analytics approaches. You will work across the full analytics stack—from defining metrics and designing experiments to building predictive models and communicating insights to leadership.

## Responsibilities

- Design and execute A/B experiments to evaluate product and operational changes across the Australian market
- Build predictive and causal models to understand consumer and merchant behaviour
- Partner with product and engineering teams to define and track key metrics
- Develop dashboards and data visualisations to communicate findings to cross-functional stakeholders
- Contribute to the team's analytical infrastructure, including pipelines and reusable modelling frameworks

## Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in data science or a related quantitative role
- Proficiency in Python or R and SQL
- Strong understanding of statistical inference, causal inference, and experimental design
- Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks (Spark, BigQuery, Redshift)
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex analyses into actionable recommendations
- A passion for building data-driven products in a fast-paced environment

## Tech Stack

Python, SQL, Spark, BigQuery, Airflow, dbt, Looker

## Benefits

- Competitive salary and equity
- Flexible hybrid working in Sydney CBD
- Health and wellness benefits
- Learning and development budget

jobs.title: AI Engineer (Consulting Graduate)
jobs.snippet: BCG X is BCG's tech, build, and design unit. Graduate AI Engineers work on real-world AI and data challenges, partnering with clients to develop innovative solutions.
jobs.description:
## About BCG X

BCG X is Boston Consulting Group's specialist AI and analytics tech-build unit, combining deep industry insight with cutting-edge technology to design, build, and scale digital products, platforms, and new ventures that drive measurable business impact. Fully integrated within BCG, we partner with the world's most important businesses and organisations.

## About the Role

As a Graduate AI Engineer at BCG X in Australia, you will tackle complex business challenges by designing, developing, and deploying cutting-edge AI and machine learning solutions for clients across industries. You will join in 2026/2027 and hit the ground running on client-facing AI projects.

## Responsibilities

- Design and implement AI/ML models for client use cases in finance, healthcare, retail, and public sector
- Build and deploy end-to-end AI solutions including data pipelines, model training, and production APIs
- Collaborate with BCG consultants, data scientists, and product managers to translate business problems into technical requirements
- Work with clients to ensure seamless integration of AI solutions into their existing workflows
- Contribute to BCG X's internal tooling, accelerators, and knowledge platforms

## Requirements

- Final-year undergraduate or postgraduate degree (completed 2024–2026) in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or Physics
- Strong programming skills in Python; experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn)
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and modern MLOps practices
- Australian citizenship or Permanent Residency required
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Office preference: Sydney, Melbourne, or Perth

## Tech Stack

Python, PyTorch, LangChain, LLM APIs, AWS/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD

## Benefits

- Competitive graduate salary with performance bonus
- Access to BCG's global learning network
- Fast-track career progression in AI consulting
- Work with Fortune 500 clients from day one

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.snippet: MYOB is building powerful AI features into its business management platform. The Senior AI Engineer will lead GenAI solution architecture, MLOps pipelines, and cross-team AI enablement for Australian SMEs.
jobs.description:
## About MYOB

MYOB is a leading business management platform serving over 1 million businesses in Australia and New Zealand. With a core purpose of helping more businesses start, survive, and succeed, MYOB is investing heavily in AI to transform financial operations for SMEs.

## About the Role

As a Senior AI Engineer at MYOB, you will be responsible for designing and building production-grade AI and GenAI systems that power the next generation of MYOB's products. You will work closely with product, data science, and platform engineering teams to bring AI capabilities to scale.

## Responsibilities

- Architect and implement AI/ML solutions including LLM-powered features, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for machine learning, including model versioning, A/B testing, and monitoring
- Lead the evaluation and integration of foundation models (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini) for business automation use cases
- Design containerised ML services using Docker and Kubernetes for high-availability deployment
- Mentor junior engineers and drive AI engineering best practices across the organisation
- Collaborate with the AI Platform team to build shared tooling and reusable AI components

## Requirements

- 5+ years of software engineering experience with 3+ years in AI/ML engineering
- Proficiency in Python and experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, Hugging Face)
- Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, and prompt engineering
- Strong background in MLOps: model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management
- Experience with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
- Excellent communication skills and ability to drive technical decisions

## Tech Stack

Python, PyTorch, LangChain, AWS Bedrock, Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, FastAPI

## Benefits

- Competitive salary package
- Flexible hybrid working in Sydney
- Stock options / equity participation
- Learning and conference budget
- Health and wellbeing allowance

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: Zip Co is a global BNPL and digital payments fintech. The Senior Data Scientist will develop ML models for credit risk, fraud detection, and growth analytics, with strong MLOps practices for model lifecycle management.
jobs.description:
## About Zip Co

Zip Co is a global buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) and digital payments platform operating in Australia, New Zealand, and the United States, with millions of customers and tens of thousands of merchant partners. The company is expanding its AI/ML capabilities to improve risk decisioning, fraud prevention, and personalisation.

## About the Role

As a Senior Data Scientist at Zip Co, you will build and deploy machine learning models that drive critical business decisions across credit risk, fraud detection, and marketing optimisation. You will take end-to-end ownership of models from conception through to production monitoring.

## Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain ML models for credit decisioning, fraud detection, and customer lifetime value prediction
- Apply causal inference and experimental design to evaluate business initiatives
- Collaborate with engineering to productionise models using MLOps best practices
- Monitor model performance in production and implement drift detection and retraining pipelines
- Mentor data scientists and contribute to the team's technical roadmap
- Communicate model outcomes and business insights to senior stakeholders

## Requirements

- 5+ years of data science experience in a commercial environment
- Strong Python skills and proficiency in ML frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch)
- Experience with credit risk or fraud modelling preferred
- Familiarity with MLOps tools for model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management (MLflow, Seldon, SageMaker)
- Solid understanding of statistical methods including regression, survival analysis, and hypothesis testing
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or GCP)

## Tech Stack

Python, scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, AWS SageMaker, MLflow, SQL, Spark, Airflow

## Benefits

- Competitive salary + bonus
- Equity/ESOP participation
- Flexible hybrid working in Sydney CBD
- L&D budget and conference attendance
- Wellness allowance

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: JPMorgan Chase's Machine Learning Centre of Excellence is hiring Data Scientists in Sydney. The team applies NLP, LLMs, Time Series, and Reinforcement Learning to solve complex financial services problems at global scale.
jobs.description:
## About JPMorgan Chase

JPMorgan Chase is one of the world's largest financial institutions with a global Machine Learning Centre of Excellence (MLCOE) of over 200 data scientists, engineers, and product managers spread across three continents and more than 10 cities, including Sydney.

## About the Role

As a Data Scientist within JPMorgan Chase's global MLCOE, you will develop and apply statistical and mathematical models to analyse complex data patterns and generate insights that drive strategic and operational decisions across the bank's businesses.

## Responsibilities

- Develop, validate, and deploy ML models for financial services applications including fraud detection, risk management, trading analytics, and customer personalisation
- Apply NLP, LLMs, and time-series modelling to large-scale financial data
- Partner with technology and business teams to translate complex analyses into actionable recommendations
- Build and maintain data pipelines and feature stores for model training and serving
- Conduct rigorous model validation, backtesting, and performance monitoring
- Contribute to the team's ML platform and infrastructure improvements

## Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in data science or quantitative analytics
- Strong proficiency in Python, R, or equivalent
- Solid foundation in statistics, machine learning, and experimental design
- Experience with NLP, LLMs, or time-series modelling is highly desirable
- Familiarity with cloud ML platforms (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI)
- Knowledge of financial services or regulated industry experience preferred
- Australian work authorisation required

## Tech Stack

Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark, Hadoop, AWS, SQL, Tableau

## Benefits

- Highly competitive salary and annual bonus
- Comprehensive health and wellbeing benefits
- Global mobility opportunities
- Access to world-class learning resources

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.snippet: Apple is hiring Machine Learning Engineers in Sydney across teams including Siri, Apple Intelligence, Maps, and System Intelligence. Roles focus on on-device ML, multi-modal perception, and large-scale inference.
jobs.description:
## About Apple

Apple's Machine Learning and AI organisation is at the forefront of on-device intelligence, responsible for the models and systems that power Siri, Apple Intelligence, Maps, Photos, and the broader Apple ecosystem. The Sydney team contributes to global ML initiatives spanning NLP, computer vision, and multi-modal AI.

## About the Role

Machine Learning Engineers at Apple Australia work on technically challenging problems at the intersection of research and production engineering. You will develop ML systems that run efficiently on Apple's custom silicon and contribute to features used by hundreds of millions of devices worldwide.

## Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and optimise machine learning models for production deployment on Apple devices and cloud infrastructure
- Collaborate with research scientists to bring state-of-the-art NLP, vision, and multi-modal models into real-world products
- Build efficient inference pipelines for Apple Silicon (A-series, M-series chips)
- Develop robust ML evaluation frameworks and continuous monitoring systems
- Contribute to Apple's internal ML tooling, data infrastructure, and model compression techniques
- Work on features including natural language understanding, voice recognition, image generation, and personalised recommendations

## Requirements

- 3+ years of industry experience in machine learning engineering
- Strong Python and C++ programming skills
- Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX
- Understanding of model optimisation techniques including quantisation, pruning, and distillation
- Experience deploying ML models to production at scale
- Passion for hardware-software co-design and efficient on-device inference

## Tech Stack

Python, C++, Swift, PyTorch, Core ML, Metal Performance Shaders, ONNX, custom Apple frameworks

## Benefits

- Highly competitive salary and RSU package
- World-class work environment in Sydney CBD
- Access to cutting-edge hardware and research collaborations
- Generous health, dental, and vision coverage

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Video AI
jobs.snippet: Canva is hiring a Senior ML Engineer for its Video AI team in Sydney. The role focuses on building generative video models, video understanding systems, and scalable inference infrastructure for Canva's 200M+ user base.
jobs.description:
## About Canva

Canva is a global visual communication platform with over 200 million users worldwide. Headquartered in Sydney, Canva is accelerating its investment in AI to empower everyone to design. The Video AI team is a key part of Canva's mission to democratise design through generative AI.

## About the Role

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Video AI team, you will develop state-of-the-art generative video models and video understanding systems that power Canva's next-generation video editing and creation features. You will work on the full ML lifecycle: from research and experimentation to production deployment at global scale.

## Responsibilities

- Design and implement generative video models (diffusion models, video transformers) for Canva's video editor
- Build video understanding pipelines for scene detection, object tracking, and content-aware editing
- Develop scalable inference infrastructure to serve video AI features to 200M+ users
- Collaborate with research scientists to translate cutting-edge video AI papers into production features
- Optimise models for latency, throughput, and cost using techniques including distillation, quantisation, and streaming inference
- Contribute to Canva's ML Platform for training, evaluation, and deployment of large video models

## Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering
- Deep expertise in deep learning frameworks (PyTorch preferred)
- Experience with video models, diffusion models, or video transformers is highly desirable
- Strong Python engineering skills and experience building production ML systems
- Familiarity with distributed training and large-scale model serving
- Experience with cloud ML infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and containerisation

## Tech Stack

PyTorch, CUDA, Triton, AWS, Kubernetes, Ray, video processing frameworks (FFmpeg, OpenCV), custom Canva ML Platform

## Benefits

- Equity (options/RSUs) in a high-growth company
- Flexible hybrid working from Canva's Sydney flagship campus
- Generous parental leave and family support
- L&D budget plus access to Canva Premium for personal use
- Catered lunches and world-class facilities

jobs.title: 数据挖掘算法工程师（暑期实习）
jobs.snippet: 希音（SHEIN）招募2026届暑期实习生，数据挖掘算法工程师岗位，工作地点广州/南京/深圳，截止日期2026年6月20日，聚焦推荐系统与用户行为建模。
jobs.description:
## 关于希音（SHEIN）

希音（SHEIN）是全球领先的时尚科技公司，总部位于广州，业务覆盖全球150+国家和地区。公司依托强大的数据驱动和算法能力，构建了高效的供应链和个性化推荐体系，成为全球增长最快的时尚平台之一。

## 岗位职责

- 参与推荐系统、搜索排序、用户画像等核心算法的研究与开发
- 利用机器学习、深度学习方法挖掘海量用户行为数据，提升推荐精准度和商品转化率
- 参与模型的离线训练、在线评估和A/B实验，推动算法效果持续迭代优化
- 与产品、工程团队紧密协作，将算法研究成果落地为生产系统
- 探索大模型（LLM）在电商推荐、用户理解方向的创新应用

## 岗位要求

- 2026届应届毕业生（毕业时间2025年9月—2026年8月），实习时长不少于3个月
- 计算机、统计学、数学、电子工程等相关专业背景
- 扎实的机器学习和深度学习基础，熟悉常用算法模型（XGBoost、DNN、Transformer等）
- 熟练掌握Python，具备TensorFlow或PyTorch实践经验
- 有推荐系统、用户行为建模或电商算法项目经验者优先

## 技术栈

Python、TensorFlow/PyTorch、Spark、SQL、推荐系统框架

## 福利待遇

- 日薪250–350元/天，月薪可达5000–7000元
- 可获实习证明，优秀实习生可转正
- 每人有2个志愿，可投递不同岗位
- 实习截止日期：2026年6月20日，滚动录取，尽早投递

jobs.title: AI for Science算法研究实习生
jobs.snippet: 深势科技是全球AI for Science领域领导者，招募算法研究实习生，研究方向涵盖蛋白质结构预测、分子大模型、科学计算与AI结合，工作地点北京五道口。
jobs.description:
## 关于深势科技（DP Technology）

深势科技是全球「AI for Science」研究范式的领导者，由清华大学知识工程实验室孵化，2018年成立，总部位于北京。公司专注于将人工智能与多尺度模拟算法相结合，推动科学研究和工业研发的根本性变革，在蛋白质结构预测、分子动力学模拟、材料科学等领域取得国际前沿成果。

## 岗位职责

- 在资深研究员指导下，参与蛋白质结构预测、蛋白质语言模型、序列设计等前沿算法研究
- 探索大模型（LLM）在科学计算、分子生成、药物发现方向的创新应用
- 参与模型设计、实验验证和代码实现，有机会以第一/共同作者发表顶会、顶刊论文
- 与计算物理、化学、生物学领域科学家密切合作，将AI技术应用于真实科学问题
- 参与开源AI for Science工具链的开发与迭代

## 岗位要求

- 在读研究生（硕士/博士）或优秀本科生，计算机、人工智能、物理、化学、生物信息等相关专业
- 扎实的机器学习和深度学习基础，熟悉PyTorch/JAX框架
- 有蛋白质建模、计算化学或相关领域项目经验者优先
- 较强的科研能力和自我驱动力，有顶会论文者加分
- 能在北京线下连续实习至少3个月

## 技术栈

Python、PyTorch/JAX、结构生物信息学工具（AlphaFold生态）、分子动力学软件、HPC集群

## 福利待遇

- 较具竞争力的实习薪资
- 顶级科研团队，一流导师配置
- 有机会参与发表高水平学术论文
- 优秀者可获转正机会
- 工作地点：北京五道口鼎好大厦

jobs.title: 算法工程师实习（推荐系统方向）
jobs.snippet: 猫眼娱乐招募算法工程师实习生，推荐系统和数据分析方向，工作地点北京，聚焦演出票务、内容推荐与用户增长算法，实习可转正。

## 岗位职责

- 参与演出票务和娱乐内容推荐系统的算法研发，包括召回、排序和重排模块
- 利用用户行为数据挖掘兴趣偏好，构建个性化推荐策略
- 参与A/B实验设计与分析，推动推荐效果的持续迭代
- 探索大模型（LLM）在娱乐内容理解、用户意图识别方向的应用
- 与产品和数据工程团队协作，将算法成果应用于线上环境

- 熟练掌握Python，具备PyTorch/TensorFlow使用经验

Python、PyTorch、Spark、Hive、SQL、推荐算法框架

jobs.title: 算法工程师实习（搜索推荐方向）
jobs.snippet: 同程旅行招募算法工程师实习生，搜索推荐方向，工作地点上海，聚焦旅行场景下的智能搜索、个性化推荐和大模型应用，实习期间可转正。

- 2026/2027届应届生，计算机、统计学、数学或相关专业

jobs.title: 数据科学家（商业数据方向）
jobs.snippet: 美团招募数据科学家，商业数据分析方向，工作地点北京，聚焦到店业务、外卖平台的用户增长分析、商家经营洞察和策略模型研发。
jobs.description:
## 关于美团

美团是中国领先的生活服务电商平台，连接6亿+消费者和数百万商家。数据科学团队为美团外卖、到店餐饮、酒旅、优选等核心业务提供数据驱动的决策支持，是美团增长引擎的核心智库。

## 岗位职责

- 深入分析用户行为数据，构建消费者增长、留存和变现的策略模型
- 设计和执行A/B实验，定量评估业务策略效果，输出可落地的增长洞察
- 建立商家经营诊断和预测模型，支持商业化产品决策
- 与产品、运营、工程团队协作，将数据分析成果转化为平台功能和策略优化
- 参与AI/大模型在数据分析和洞察生成方向的探索应用

## 岗位要求

- 3年以上数据科学或量化分析工作经验
- 熟练掌握Python和SQL，具备机器学习建模能力（XGBoost、LightGBM、因果推断）
- 深入理解统计推断、实验设计（A/B测试、DID、工具变量等因果分析方法）
- 具备优秀的数据可视化和沟通能力，能向业务侧清晰传递分析结论
- 本科及以上学历，统计学、数学、计算机或相关专业
- 有互联网平台或电商业务经验者优先

## 技术栈

Python、SQL、Spark、Hive、XGBoost/LightGBM、因果推断框架、Tableau/SuperSet

## 福利待遇

- 行业竞争力薪资 + 年终奖
- 五险一金 + 补充医疗
- 期权激励计划
- 弹性工作制，北京总部办公

jobs.title: 数据工程师实习（平台工程方向）
jobs.snippet: 美团招募数据工程师实习生，平台工程方向，聚焦实时数据湖、流批一体架构和数据中台基础设施建设，工作地点北京，优秀者可转正。
jobs.description:
## 关于美团数据平台

美团数据平台团队构建和维护支撑亿级用户规模的实时数据基础设施，包括实时数仓、特征平台、数据湖和AI训练数据工厂。团队面向全公司提供数据服务，是美团技术体系的核心底座。

## 岗位职责

- 参与实时数据仓库和流批一体数据处理架构的开发与优化
- 建设高可用、高性能的数据管道，支撑美团外卖、到店、优选等核心业务的数据需求
- 参与数据湖（基于Iceberg/Hudi）和数据中台平台功能的研发
- 优化数据计算资源调度和存储成本，提升平台稳定性和处理效率
- 参与AI训练数据平台建设，支持大模型训练数据的高效生产和管理

## 岗位要求

- 2026/2027届应届生，计算机、软件工程或相关专业
- 熟悉Java或Scala，了解分布式计算框架（Flink、Spark）
- 了解大数据生态（Hive、HBase、Kafka、Iceberg/Hudi等）
- 具备扎实的编程基础和系统设计思维
- 有开源大数据项目贡献或相关实习经历者优先
- 实习时长不少于3个月，北京线下办公

## 技术栈

Java/Scala/Python、Flink、Spark、Kafka、Hive、Iceberg、HDFS、ClickHouse

## 福利待遇

- 日薪200–350元/天（视学历和经验）
- 优秀实习生享受转正绿色通道
- 实习期间餐补和交通补贴
- 参与内部技术分享和培训

jobs.title: 大数据算法工程师（推荐与增长方向）
jobs.snippet: 数数科技（ThinkingData）是专注SaaS数据分析平台的科技公司，招募大数据算法工程师，聚焦用户行为分析、推荐算法和AI增长模型，工作地点上海。
jobs.description:
## 关于数数科技（ThinkingData）

数数科技是专注企业级数据分析和增长SaaS平台的科技公司，产品TE系统（ThinkingEngine）服务全球500+家企业客户，覆盖游戏、电商、金融、互联网等多个行业，帮助企业实现数据驱动的精细化运营和增长。公司研发团队位于上海，是国内领先的数据技术服务商之一。

## 岗位职责

- 参与TE数据分析平台中推荐算法和增长模型模块的研发
- 利用用户行为大数据，构建用户分群、留存预测和变现优化模型
- 设计基于机器学习的智能推荐和个性化策略，赋能客户的精细化运营
- 参与平台查询引擎和数据分析能力的性能优化
- 探索大模型（LLM）在自然语言数据查询和智能报告生成方向的应用

## 岗位要求

- 3年以上大数据或算法工程工作经验
- 熟练掌握Python/Java/Scala，具备Spark/Flink等分布式计算框架开发经验
- 掌握常用机器学习算法，了解推荐系统或用户增长建模实践
- 熟悉ClickHouse、Doris等列式存储数据库
- 有数据分析SaaS产品研发经验者优先
- 本科及以上学历，计算机、统计或相关专业

## 技术栈

Python/Java/Scala、Spark、Flink、ClickHouse、Doris、Kafka、Hive、scikit-learn/PyTorch

## 福利待遇

- 行业竞争力薪资（15–25薪）
- 五险一金，弹性工作时间
- 股权激励（部分职级）
- 每年技术大会参会机会

jobs.title: AI算法工程师实习（旅游推荐方向）
jobs.snippet: 途牛旅游招募AI算法工程师实习生，旅游推荐方向，工作地点南京，聚焦个性化旅游产品推荐、行程规划智能化和用户意图识别，实习可留用。
jobs.description:
## 关于途牛旅游

途牛旅游网是中国领先的在线休闲旅游服务平台，总部位于南京，提供跟团游、自由行、周边游等丰富旅游产品，累计服务用户超4000万。技术团队专注于旅游垂直场景的智能推荐、行程规划和大模型应用，驱动平台个性化服务升级。

## 岗位职责

- 参与旅游产品推荐系统的算法研发，涵盖召回、粗排、精排全链路优化
- 利用用户旅游偏好数据，构建个性化目的地和产品推荐模型
- 探索大模型（LLM）在行程规划生成、用户咨询意图识别方向的应用
- 参与基于用户评价和行为数据的内容理解和情感分析模型开发
- 设计实验方案，通过数据驱动方法持续迭代推荐效果

## 岗位要求

- 2026/2027届应届生，计算机、统计学、数学等相关专业
- 掌握机器学习和深度学习基础，了解推荐系统原理（矩阵分解、双塔模型、图推荐等）
- 熟练使用Python，具备PyTorch/TensorFlow使用经验
- 熟悉SQL，有Spark/Hive等大数据工具经验者优先
- 有旅游、电商或内容推荐相关实习经历者优先
- 实习地点：南京，时长不少于3个月

## 技术栈

Python、PyTorch/TensorFlow、Spark、SQL、Elasticsearch（向量搜索）、LLM应用框架

## 福利待遇

- 日薪150–250元/天
- 优秀实习生可留用转正
- 实习期间享受餐补和交通补贴
- 南京工作/生活成本友好
